The portfolio includes companies at all stages of development. We invest in a wide range of industries, domains and applications. The goals of sustainability , profitability and equality are common to all. Investment Strategy Chalmers Ventures is an evergreen structure that invests in tech companies that resolve both global challenges and offer great business potential. Chalmers Ventures invests in early stages with the capacity to provide growth capital to selected companies. Chalmers Ventures is always looking to syndicate with other investors and has a large network of active players, from the very earliest stages to the later ones, leveraging the capital invested in the companies.
